description: an action button or navigation link with shared sizes, variants and loading states.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents activation, including link navigation, and marks the control as disabled.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: Suggested download filename when href is set. A nonempty value requests a download; browser and server rules determine whether it is honored.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Destination URL. A nonempty value renders a link instead of a native button.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Displays a loading spinner and prevents activation while present.

attributes.name: loading-mode
attributes.description: Spinner layout while loading: replace hides the label; inline keeps the label beside the spinner.

attributes.name: outlined
attributes.description: Uses an outlined appearance instead of a filled background.

attributes.name: pill
attributes.description: Rounds the button ends to form a pill.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description: Space-separated relationship tokens forwarded to the link, for example noopener noreferrer; applies only with href.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Button size preset: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl; controls text size and padding.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Browsing context for href, such as _self, _blank or a named frame; ignored in native button mode.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Native button action: button, submit or reset; ignored when href makes the control a link.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click event bubbling from the inner button or link when activated by pointer or keyboard; disabled controls suppress activation. This is not a CustomEvent, so there is no custom detail payload.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-accent
cssproperties.description: Accent color used for outlined text and borders, and for the hover border; depends on variant.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-background
cssproperties.description: Background color of the button or link; variant and outlined can change it.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-border-color
cssproperties.description: Border color of the button or link in its resting state.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-focus-ring-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the outer ring shown on keyboard focus and hover.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-font-size
cssproperties.description: Font size of the button label; size presets also update this value.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-foreground
cssproperties.description: Text and icon color of the button or link.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-outline-background
cssproperties.description: Background color of an enabled outlined button on hover.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-padding-block
cssproperties.description: Inner spacing above and below the button content.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-padding-inline
cssproperties.description: Inner spacing before and after the button content.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-radius
cssproperties.description: Corner radius of the button or link; pill uses a fully rounded radius.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-spinner-border-width
cssproperties.description: Stroke thickness of the circular loading indicator.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-spinner-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of the circular loading indicator.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-button>` element implements the <tp-icon name="button" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Button functionality: an action button or navigation link with shared sizes, variants and loading states.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Button | Click to perform the action identified by its label. Disabled controls cannot be activated. |
| Navigation button | Click to open its destination. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Activate the focused button or link. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate a focused action button; links use <kbd>Enter</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Uses the browser's native button activation behavior.
